title: Provide the GitHub PAT so a cloud run can complete end to end
description:
HUMAN ACTION — the last thing standing between Phase 1 and its definition of done. Everything else is built, deployed and verified live.

Create a fine-grained personal access token scoped to pengelbrecht/ticks with Contents: Read and write and Pull requests: Read and write:
  https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new

Then either paste it when prompted by:
  tk factory setup --gateway-url https://gateway.ai.cloudflare.com/v1/<account>/default --provider workers-ai --cloudflare-api-token <token>
or hand it to the orchestrator to run that command.

Why the orchestrator cannot do this: a PAT is a credential on the operators own GitHub account. The AI Gateway rung is already satisfiable — the Cloudflare token now has gateway access and two gateways exist (default, agentwiki) — and workers-ai needs no provider key because inference bills to the same Cloudflare account.

What is already proven live, so this really is the last step:
- tk factory deploy builds the sandbox image from source at the deployed commit, pushes it, and deploys the container application (ticks-orchestrator) plus the Worker and the ticks-run Workflow.
- /health reports run_rooms, artifacts, db, run_workflow and sandboxes all true, auth required and configured.
- All four D1 migrations are applied to the live database.
- tk cloud status answers from the live factory.
- tk cloud run 72y reaches the factory, authenticates, and is refused with exactly the designed message: no AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL configured, run tk factory setup. An actionable stop, never a silent fallback.
notes:
2026-08-20 07:41 - A better path than this manual PAT is filed as vdg: ship a public OAuth client id for a ticks GitHub App and run the DEVICE FLOW in tk factory setup — one browser approval, repos chosen at install, short-lived and refreshable, and narrower than both the fine-grained PAT and the gh token. Until that lands, this tick's manual PAT remains the way to finish a run.
2026-08-20 07:43 - [human] Operator decision (human, 2026-08-20): use the existing gh OAuth token rather than minting a fine-grained PAT — option B, chosen with the blast radius stated (admin:org, admin:public_key, repo, workflow, across every repo on the account) and revocable via gh auth refresh. Recorded here so the choice is visible rather than implicit, and so vdg (device flow) remains the intended replacement.
2026-08-20 12:40 - Unblocked and verified: the GitHub credential is configured and tk factory status reports it can write to pengelbrecht/ticks. The first completed cloud run then reached the skill loop and made a real model call, so the credential rung is no longer what stops a run — eb5 is.
acceptance_criteria: tk factory setup completes all four rungs; tk cloud run on a pushed epic boots a container, reaches the skill loop, and leaves harness output in R2.
